title: Conversation
summary: The scrolling message list: follows the stream, stops when you scroll up, jumps back to the latest.

title: Messages
summary: A user or assistant message with its parts and actions (copy, read aloud, regenerate, …).

title: Prompt input
summary: The composer: text, attachments, dictation, send and stop, queueing while the agent works.

title: Suggestions
summary: Tappable prompt suggestions.

title: Empty state
summary: The start of a conversation: a greeting and suggestions.

title: Branch
summary: Switch between regenerated versions of a reply.

title: Checkpoint
summary: Restore the conversation to an earlier point, after confirming.

title: Queue
summary: Messages waiting to be sent while the agent is busy.

title: Open in chat
summary: Continue a prompt in another chat app.

title: Model selector
summary: Pick a model, with its provider, capabilities and context window.

title: Context (token usage)
summary: Tokens used by the conversation, against the model's context window.

title: Loading indicators
summary: Material 3 Expressive loading indicators while a reply starts.

title: Shimmer
summary: Text with a moving highlight, for work in progress.

title: Markdown
summary: GitHub-flavoured Markdown, rendered as it streams.

title: Code block
summary: Code with syntax highlighting, a language label and copy.

title: Math (KaTeX)
summary: Inline and display math, offline.

title: Mermaid · flowchart
summary: Mermaid diagrams, bundled and offline: a flowchart.

title: Mermaid · sequence
summary: A sequence diagram.

title: Mermaid · class
summary: A class diagram.

title: Mermaid · pie
summary: A pie chart.

title: Mermaid · streaming
summary: A diagram still streaming: the source, until it is complete.

title: Reasoning
summary: The model's thinking: one quiet line that expands.

title: Sources
summary: The sources a reply used.

title: Inline citation
summary: [n] markers in the text, linked to their sources.

title: Tool calls
summary: A tool call with its input, output or error, progress, and what provides it.

title: Sub-agents
summary: A delegated agent's run, nested in the call that started it.

title: Agent's computer
summary: Each step as the agent saw it (screenshot, terminal, diff, file), with a timeline, autoplay, back to live and replay.

title: Agent's computer · in a reply
summary: The live preview card under a reply that works on a computer; it opens the panel.

title: Step views
summary: A step by its category: a browser frame with the screenshot, a terminal, a diff.

title: Agent
summary: An agent's card: model, instructions, tools and output schema.

title: Confirmation (tool approval)
summary: Approve or deny a tool call, with a reason or edited arguments.

title: Question
summary: A multiple-choice question from the agent.

title: Input request (form)
summary: A form the agent asks the user to fill, from a JSON Schema (AG-UI interrupts, MCP elicitation).

title: Plan
summary: The agent's plan and the step it is on.

title: Task
summary: A task and the files it touched.

title: Chain of thought
summary: The steps of the agent's reasoning, with their sources.

title: Data parts (data-plan, data-task)
summary: Custom data parts: known names render as elements, others as data.

title: JSX · Text and layout
summary: Model-written JSX rendered natively: headings, text, lists, dividers.

title: JSX · Form with bindings and an action
summary: Inputs bound to the data model; `onClick={subscribe}` sends an action with it.

title: JSX · Choices, slider, date and tabs
summary: `<select>` / `<option>`, `<Slider>`, `<DateTimeInput>` and `<Tabs>` in JSX.

title: JSX · A row of cards from data
summary: A layout of cards whose values come from bindings, and a link.

title: JSX · Streaming
summary: JSX rendered while it streams in: half-written tags wait, what the user typed stays.

title: A2UI surface
summary: An A2UI v1.0 surface (the reference server's booking form) rendered natively.

title: Artifact
summary: A generated artifact with its actions.

title: Web preview
summary: A generated page or URL in a sandboxed WebView.

title: Image
summary: An image, upright by EXIF; tap for the viewer (zoom, pan, rotate).

title: Attachments
summary: Files attached to a prompt, removable, and images that open full screen.

title: Video
summary: A video's first frame and duration; plays full screen.

title: Document (PDF)
summary: A PDF's first page and page count; every page in the viewer. Other formats open in an app.

title: Audio player + Transcription
summary: Audio with a transcript that follows it and seeks on tap.

title: Voice mode
summary: A hands-free conversation over the chat's controller.

title: Persona
summary: The assistant's animated presence: idle, listening, thinking, speaking.

title: Speech input
summary: Dictation with the platform speech recognizer.

title: Mic & voice selectors
summary: Choose the microphone and the reading voice.

title: Terminal
summary: Command output as a terminal shows it: colours, progress bars, links.

title: Stack trace
summary: A stack trace with app frames first and library frames folded.

title: Test results
summary: Test suites with passed, failed and skipped cases.

title: File tree
summary: A project's files, with change badges.

title: Commit
summary: A commit with its message and changed files.

title: Schema display
summary: An API endpoint: parameters, request and response.

title: Package info
summary: A dependency change and its size.

title: Environment variables
summary: Environment variables with secrets masked until revealed.

title: Sandbox
summary: Code and its output in tabs.

title: Snippet
summary: A one-line command to copy.

title: Canvas / Node / Edge
summary: An agent run as a graph: nodes, edges, labels, pan and zoom.
elements: Canvas, Node, Edge, Controls, Panel, Toolbar
